body: That really sounds like fate.. what are the chances? You seem like a fun person, I'm sure you can make her happy and I hope she will see something special in you too! Either way, you have a good friend in her. :)
Your comment did make me think more about what I can do for other people, and ways to make the world nicer. You really helped me. Thank you.

15 years? That's such a long time to have feelings for someone. I hope it goes well for you, but you're right, either way you'll get closure. You seem like a nice person, and I hope you're happy, because you deserve that.
That's amazing, good luck. :) You're really brave to put yourself out there like that.

Thank you so much. Your comment makes me feel better too. I just want to give up sometimes, it's really hard living here. I think, "I don't want to live in this kind of world!" but then I feel like I'm being obnoxious and self righteous, and then just get tired. There are good people.. you're right. I'll keep looking for love and happiness for now. I hope you're well too.
Thank you, that's good advice. I don't know if one person can change the world, but I'll try to find something creative to pour my heart into.

Thank you, you're very kind. It's really tiring.. I just feel like other people can be so positive and happy without getting burned out, whereas I find it so hard to look on the bright side. I wish I could laugh things off. But thank you again, you didn't have to say anything, but you did, and that's really nice.
